generic.title: The operation could not be completed
generic.description: The system could not process the request.
generic.recommendation: Try again. If the error repeats, contact support and quote the request code.

queued.title: You are in the queue
queued.description: The system is under peak load: your request was accepted and will be processed in turn.
queued.recommendation: Keep this page open — the result will appear automatically.

IAM_FORBIDDEN.title: No access to this section
IAM_FORBIDDEN.description: The current working context does not grant rights to this section.
IAM_FORBIDDEN.recommendation: Switch the working context or request access from the system administrator.

IAM_UNAUTHORIZED.title: Session ended
IAM_UNAUTHORIZED.description: The session expired and the system signed you out.
IAM_UNAUTHORIZED.recommendation: Sign in again — unsaved changes will have to be entered once more.

NOT_FOUND.title: Record not found
NOT_FOUND.description: The object was deleted or the link is out of date.
NOT_FOUND.recommendation: Return to the list and open the record again.

NETWORK_OFFLINE.title: Connection lost
NETWORK_OFFLINE.description: The server is unreachable and changes were not saved.
NETWORK_OFFLINE.recommendation: Check your network connection and retry — the data you entered stays on screen.

SERVER_ERROR.title: The server did not respond
SERVER_ERROR.description: An error on the system side; no data was lost.
SERVER_ERROR.recommendation: Retry in a minute. If the error repeats, quote the request code to support.

INTEGRATION_UNAVAILABLE.title: External service unavailable
INTEGRATION_UNAVAILABLE.description: A dependent service did not respond; the rest of your work continues.
INTEGRATION_UNAVAILABLE.recommendation: Reload this block later — other sections remain available.

REG_WINDOW_CLOSED.title: Registration window is closed
REG_WINDOW_CLOSED.description: Registration for your year and programme is not open right now.
REG_WINDOW_CLOSED.recommendation: The registrar's office publishes registration dates. Contact them if the window should be open.

REG_CREDITS_OUT_OF_RANGE.title: Credits out of the allowed range
REG_CREDITS_OUT_OF_RANGE.description: With this change, the total credits in your plan would fall outside the limits set for the semester.
REG_CREDITS_OUT_OF_RANGE.recommendation: Remove an elective or add the missing credits. Only the registrar's office can allow an overload.

REG_PREREQ_NOT_MET.title: Prerequisites not completed
REG_PREREQ_NOT_MET.description: You need to complete earlier courses before enrolling in this one.
REG_PREREQ_NOT_MET.recommendation: Contact your advisor: they can waive the requirement with a comment.

REG_OFFERING_FULL.title: No seats left with this teacher
REG_OFFERING_FULL.description: The group filled up while you were choosing.
REG_OFFERING_FULL.recommendation: Join the waitlist or choose another teacher.

REG_DUPLICATE_DISCIPLINE.title: Course already in your plan
REG_DUPLICATE_DISCIPLINE.description: A plan cannot contain two groups of the same course.
REG_DUPLICATE_DISCIPLINE.recommendation: To move to another teacher, use “Change teacher”.

REG_LANGUAGE_MISMATCH.title: Language of instruction does not match
REG_LANGUAGE_MISMATCH.description: The group's language is not one of your languages of instruction.
REG_LANGUAGE_MISMATCH.recommendation: Choose a group in your language of instruction or contact the registrar's office.

REG_PLAN_LOCKED.title: The study plan cannot be changed
REG_PLAN_LOCKED.description: The plan has been sent to your advisor or already approved.
REG_PLAN_LOCKED.recommendation: Ask your advisor to return the plan, or wait for the add/drop period.

REG_MANDATORY_DISCIPLINE.title: A mandatory course cannot be removed
REG_MANDATORY_DISCIPLINE.description: Mandatory courses for the semester are always part of the plan.
REG_MANDATORY_DISCIPLINE.recommendation: You can change the teacher if there are several.

REG_TEACHER_NOT_CHOSEN.title: No teacher chosen
REG_TEACHER_NOT_CHOSEN.description: A teacher has not yet been chosen for one of the mandatory courses.
REG_TEACHER_NOT_CHOSEN.recommendation: Choose a teacher and send the plan again.

REG_PLAN_NOT_SUBMITTED.title: Study plan is not awaiting approval
REG_PLAN_NOT_SUBMITTED.description: You can only approve or return a plan the student has sent to their advisor.
REG_PLAN_NOT_SUBMITTED.recommendation: Refresh the list — another staff member may have approved it, or the student has not sent it yet.

REG_PLAN_HAS_ERRORS.title: The study plan has issues
REG_PLAN_HAS_ERRORS.description: A plan with check errors cannot be approved.
REG_PLAN_HAS_ERRORS.recommendation: Waive the prerequisite with a justification, or return the plan to the student with a comment.

REG_OFFERING_CLOSED.title: The group is already closed
REG_OFFERING_CLOSED.description: This section was closed earlier and cannot be closed again.

REG_REASSIGN_INVALID.title: Cannot move students there
REG_REASSIGN_INVALID.description: The selected group is closed or belongs to another course.
REG_REASSIGN_INVALID.recommendation: Choose an open group of the same course, or close without moving.

SCH_LESSON_CANCELLED.title: The class is cancelled
SCH_LESSON_CANCELLED.description: A cancelled class cannot be marked as held.
SCH_LESSON_CANCELLED.recommendation: If the class did take place, inform the department.

SCH_LESSON_IN_FUTURE.title: The class has not happened yet
SCH_LESSON_IN_FUTURE.description: You can mark a class as held on the day or later.
SCH_LESSON_IN_FUTURE.recommendation: Come back to mark it after the class.

SCH_CHANGE_REQUEST_EXISTS.title: Request already sent
SCH_CHANGE_REQUEST_EXISTS.description: There is already a substitution request for this class.
SCH_CHANGE_REQUEST_EXISTS.recommendation: You can see its status under “Substitution requests”.

SCH_CONFLICT_TEACHER.title: The teacher is busy
SCH_CONFLICT_TEACHER.description: The teacher already has a class at this time (H-01).
SCH_CONFLICT_TEACHER.recommendation: Choose another slot — “Find a slot” lists only free ones.

SCH_CONFLICT_GROUP.title: The group is busy
SCH_CONFLICT_GROUP.description: The group or its subgroup already has a class at this time (H-02).
SCH_CONFLICT_GROUP.recommendation: Choose another slot — “Find a slot” lists only free ones.

SCH_CONFLICT_ROOM.title: The room is taken
SCH_CONFLICT_ROOM.description: Another class already uses this room at this time (H-03).
SCH_CONFLICT_ROOM.recommendation: Choose another room with “Find a room”.

SCH_ROOM_CAPACITY.title: The room is too small
SCH_ROOM_CAPACITY.description: The room has fewer seats than students in the class (H-04).
SCH_ROOM_CAPACITY.recommendation: Choose a larger room with “Find a room”.

SCH_ROOM_KIND.title: The room does not fit
SCH_ROOM_KIND.description: The room type does not match the class (H-05).
SCH_ROOM_KIND.recommendation: Choose a room of the right type with “Find a room”.

SCH_UNAVAILABLE.title: Time unavailable
SCH_UNAVAILABLE.description: The teacher, group or room is unavailable at this time (H-06).

SCH_VERSION_LOCKED.title: The version cannot be changed
SCH_VERSION_LOCKED.description: The version is not a draft.
SCH_VERSION_LOCKED.recommendation: Changes to an approved version go through substitutions and rescheduling, or a new version.

SCH_HARD_CONFLICTS.title: There are hard violations
SCH_HARD_CONFLICTS.description: A timetable with hard violations cannot be approved or published.
SCH_HARD_CONFLICTS.recommendation: Resolve the conflicts manually or run the solver.

SCH_SOLVE_RUNNING.title: The solver is running
SCH_SOLVE_RUNNING.description: The version cannot be changed while the solver builds the timetable.
SCH_SOLVE_RUNNING.recommendation: Wait for it to finish or stop the solver.

SCH_LESSON_PINNED.title: The class is pinned
SCH_LESSON_PINNED.description: A pinned class cannot be moved (H-12).
SCH_LESSON_PINNED.recommendation: Unpin the class to move it.

REG_SEATS_BELOW_TAKEN.title: Fewer seats than enrolled students
REG_SEATS_BELOW_TAKEN.description: You cannot reduce the number of seats below the students already enrolled.
REG_SEATS_BELOW_TAKEN.recommendation: Keep at least as many seats as enrolled students, or open another group.

SCH_CHANGE_DECIDED.title: Already decided
SCH_CHANGE_DECIDED.description: The department has already decided on this request.

SCH_REVIEW_PENDING.title: Not all departments have approved
SCH_REVIEW_PENDING.description: A version can be approved once all departments have reviewed it.
SCH_REVIEW_PENDING.recommendation: Wait for the review, or contact the departments that left comments.

COH_NOT_SIBLING.title: Cannot move there
COH_NOT_SIBLING.description: A student can only be moved to a neighbouring group or subgroup at the same level.
COH_NOT_SIBLING.recommendation: Choose a group from the list next to the student.

COH_STREAM_TEACHER.title: The department assigns the stream lecturer
COH_STREAM_TEACHER.description: The stream's teacher is set in the department's section.
COH_STREAM_TEACHER.recommendation: Change the section under Department, or assign a teacher to a group.

COH_NOT_BUILT.title: Streams are not formed yet
COH_NOT_BUILT.description: Only formed streams and groups can be sent to the scheduler.

TERM_WINDOW_DATES.title: Invalid window dates
TERM_WINDOW_DATES.description: The registration window ends before it starts.
TERM_WINDOW_DATES.recommendation: Check the dates and save again.

TERM_CREDITS_RANGE.title: Invalid credit range
TERM_CREDITS_RANGE.description: The minimum is above the maximum, or values are out of range.
TERM_CREDITS_RANGE.recommendation: Use a minimum from 1 and a maximum not above 40.

TERM_SLOTS_OVERLAP.title: Periods overlap
TERM_SLOTS_OVERLAP.description: A period starts before the previous one ends, or ends before it starts.
TERM_SLOTS_OVERLAP.recommendation: Fix the times so periods follow in order.

ROOM_EXISTS.title: This room already exists
ROOM_EXISTS.description: The building already has a room with this number.
ROOM_EXISTS.recommendation: Edit the existing room or use another number.
